dispositions.topic_text: Atomicity and residual state if first lock creation is interrupted
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): a first lock creation cut short leaves at most an empty lock file and its folders, which the next call uses as they stand.

dispositions.topic_text: Durability required for the lock file and parent folders before returning the held lock
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): the lock file and its folders are not synchronised; losing them in a host crash only means they are created again on next use.
